assertion.statement: At the admitted known simple-zero constituent h with nonzero complementary central value for hk, the generic primitive class-functional coordinate is regular at t=0 and specializes to the actual central tensor.
assertion.objects: The retained primitive complex over Lambda_(t), its actual cycle and closed functional, and the same h,k constituent.
assertion.hypotheses: The first twist has a simple analytic zero and the companion central value is nonzero; forward rank and finiteness, the height formula, nonzero finite-class multipliers, and retained finite free models are supplied.
assertion.quantifiers: Each admitted known simple-zero constituent satisfying the stated ring-class and local hypotheses.
assertion.parameter_range: Fixed K=Q(sqrt(k)), with active primes split in K; localization at (t) with residue Q2.
assertion.uniformity: This proves regularity and tensor identity, not the later numerical valuation bound.
assertion.constants: The generic and central cohomology dimensions are (1,1) in degrees one and two and zero elsewhere.
assertion.normalizations: Cancel only unit disks. The nonzero central cycle gives a nonzero generic kernel; semicontinuity and Euler characteristic then give exact dimension equality.
assertion.exceptional_cases: The unknown base constituent is not assumed to satisfy these analytic hypotheses. No numerical calibration or later uniform determinant bound is used to prove regularity.
assertion.limit_order: Use forward rank and finite Sha at known constituents; establish central dimensions and nonzero cycle; prove generic dimensions; only then apply no-jump specialization.

assertion.statement: At a known simple-zero constituent, the primitive central valuation equals 2j_rc(h,k)-4omega(h)-s(h)-s(hk)-sum_{p|k}t_p+O_{E,pi}(1), with 0<=t_p<=2 and t_p=2 for the full rational two-torsion curve.
assertion.objects: The same retained class-functional tensor, ordinary Kummer complex of Res_{K/Q}(E^h), product E^h times E^(hk), and their dual sum/difference isogenies.
assertion.hypotheses: Known-zero regularity and the same-point central identity, finite Sha from forward theorems, integral Kummer duality, Milne arithmetic isogeny ratio, local quotient lengths and the tame component-group description are supplied.
assertion.quantifiers: Each admitted h,k with the first twist a known simple zero and companion nonzero central value.
assertion.parameter_range: All active primes split in K; companion primes are tame good primes for E^h. Old local types and L are fixed.
assertion.uniformity: The remaining error depends only on fixed E, pi, old local types and multiplier, not h,k. The companion sum is not absorbed before omega(k) is bounded.
assertion.constants: Ordinary tensor valuation 2j_rc+2v2(Lm)+2g_A-s_A; two moving lengths cancel 2v2(m); each active prime contributes -4; IJ=2, regulator ratio2/I^2, cotangent ab=4.
assertion.normalizations: Use actual integral determinant torsion disks with sign (-1)^(i+1), pullback Neron measures, and the rational points of the finite etale component scheme. No BSD leading-term equality is assumed.
assertion.exceptional_cases: Do not discard degree-one or degree-three rational torsion, absorb unbounded Sha lengths, or replace component schemes by geometric cardinalities. At companion primes the Weil restriction is connected and the ramified twist contributes E[2]^Frob.
assertion.limit_order: Compute ordinary integral torsion and both free coefficients; subtract moving and active quotient lengths; apply the algebraic isogeny ratio with the same measures; retain the negative companion sum until a separate bound permits absorption.
